## ORIGINAL USER REQUEST
Build a scalable multi-vendor B2B e-commerce backend platform with inventory management, role-based access control, secure payment processing, automated shipping tracking, complex discount engines, and comprehensive reporting.

## TARGET FILE
- Path: package.json
- Description: Defines project dependencies like express, mongoose, bcrypt, and jsonwebtoken.

## PROJECT NAME
enterprise-multivendor-b2b

## ENTITIES
### User
Description: Represents system users including admins, vendors, and customers.
Fields:
- name: String (required)
- email: String (required, unique)
- password: String (required)
- role: String (required)
- isActive: Boolean (required)

### Vendor
Description: Represents store vendors and marketplace sellers.
Fields:
- userId: ObjectId (required, unique)
- storeName: String (required, unique)
- commissionRate: Number (required)
- isVerified: Boolean (required)

### Product
Description: Represents items offered by vendors in the store.
Fields:
- vendorId: ObjectId (required)
- title: String (required)
- sku: String (required, unique)
- price: Number (required)
- stockQuantity: Number (required)

### Category
Description: Represents hierarchical product classification.
Fields:
- name: String (required, unique)
- slug: String (required, unique)
- parentId: ObjectId

### Order
Description: Represents customer placed orders.
Fields:
- customerId: ObjectId (required)
- totalAmount: Number (required)
- status: String (required)
- shippingAddress: String (required)

### OrderItem
Description: Represents granular line items within an order associated with specific vendors.
Fields:
- orderId: ObjectId (required)
- productId: ObjectId (required)
- vendorId: ObjectId (required)
- quantity: Number (required)
- price: Number (required)

### Review
Description: Represents product ratings and feedback left by customers.
Fields:
- productId: ObjectId (required)
- customerId: ObjectId (required)
- rating: Number (required)
- comment: String

### Coupon
Description: Represents promotional discount codes applied during checkout.
Fields:
- code: String (required, unique)
- discountPercentage: Number (required)
- expirationDate: Date (required)

## FEATURES
- JWT Authentication: Secure user registration and login using JSON Web Tokens with password hashing via bcrypt.
- Role-Based Access Control: Enforce granular permissions distinguishing between Customers, Vendors, and Admins across API routes.
- Inventory Management: Real-time stock deduction and alerts during order creation and product updates.
- Multi-Vendor Order Splitting: Automatically dispatches order items to respective vendor profiles and calculates specific commissions.
- Advanced Product Search: Filter and search products by categories, price range, stock levels, and vendor IDs.
- Sales Aggregation Reporting: Generate aggregated financial performance metrics for vendors and platform admins.
